fact_text: Barkat Frisian is a joint venture between a local partner and the international dairy group Friesland, which also launched Friesland Campina, known for Olpers milk, in Pakistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Before the joint venture, the local partners supplied raw eggs to two local FMCG companies; together with the international partner they then installed a pasteurisation plant in Pakistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst credits the international partner's quality controls and product specifications for multinational food firms switching from imported raw eggs to locally pasteurised eggs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst describes Barkat Frisian as effectively a monopoly in pasteurised eggs in Pakistan, and treats that position as the core of its growth story.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The existing Port Qasim plant buys raw eggs from Sindh, so inbound freight to the plant is a major cost line.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Barkat Frisian is a certified supplier to Unilever and another global FMCG group, and its customers also include large biscuit and food makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pasteurisation greatly extends the shelf life of eggs, up to about a year when stored at the correct temperature, which adds a second benefit beyond easier handling.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Barkat Frisian's revenue was about PKR 1 billion in FY20.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Barkat Frisian's revenue reached about PKR 7.5 billion roughly four years after FY20, which the transcript places around FY24.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: At the FY24 year-end, Barkat Frisian had about PKR 1 billion of customer receivables and about PKR 240 million of credit from its suppliers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects revenue growth to continue because the company dominates pasteurised eggs and demand is well above its current output.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Barkat Frisian's 2025 IPO proceeds were to fund a new pasteurisation plant in Faisalabad rather than an expansion of the existing Port Qasim plant in Karachi.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says the Faisalabad plant is mainly a logistics decision: it cuts raw-egg inbound freight and delivery freight to Punjab customers, and it is cheaper than expanding the Karachi plant.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst estimates the Faisalabad logistics change saves about PKR 15 per kg, roughly 4 percentage points of net margin on pasteurised eggs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Barkat Frisian's customers pay after two to three months, so its cash cycle is long and profit is largely reinvested in working capital rather than paid out as dividends.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Fast sales growth ties up about two to three months of incremental sales in working capital, so a fast-growing company with a long cash cycle reinvests most of its profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues Barkat Frisian can become a multibagger only if it improves its cash cycle and margins, because neither pricing power nor cash conversion is strong today.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Multinational food companies in Pakistan often pay their suppliers late and sell mostly for cash, giving balanced or negative cash cycles that let them earn profit with little capital.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Multinational food companies with balanced or negative cash cycles trade near 20 times earnings, and the analyst argues a local firm with a weaker cash cycle should not be valued at that multiple.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Only a high return on capital can justify a high P/E, because the premium is paid back only if profits compound strongly over time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In the short term the market votes on hype, but over the long term it weighs fundamentals, so hype can lift a new listing for a while without proving its value.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Heavily oversubscribed small IPOs draw hype bids, because investors expect even a small allocation to sell at a higher price within weeks; oversubscription alone is not evidence of fundamentals.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Barkat Frisian's IPO was oversubscribed about 65 times, with a raise of roughly PKR 1 billion drawing bids worth about PKR 65 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's model projects Barkat Frisian revenue of about PKR 25 billion in FY30, roughly 3.5 times FY24 levels, using the company's own IPO model figures.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: On the analyst's FY30 estimate of about PKR 2 billion profit at an 8% net margin, a 10x versus 15x P/E would imply a company value of about PKR 20 billion versus PKR 30 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: At about 50 grams per egg, a 20,000-tonne annual capacity equals roughly 400 million eggs per year, which is how the analyst converts plant tonnage into egg volume.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says Pakistani egg prices are low by global standards because labour costs are low, which gives local processors a raw-material cost advantage.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Exports earn higher margins than local sales, and local prices sit below import parity despite local shortage, which the analyst reads as limited pricing power.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pricing power matters most: a company with a 10% net margin that raises prices 10% with no cost change nearly doubles its margin, far faster than growing volume that needs capex and working capital.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Return on capital for an expansion is profit divided by the capex plus the working capital the expansion needs, and the analyst applies this to the planned plant.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst reads management's approach as expanding volume and the customer base first and raising prices later, which delays the cash-cycle and margin improvement.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Barkat Frisian - Hottest IPO of 2025. All You Need to Know Before Investing!!' (YouTube transcript, undated)
